spec.description: Real-time monitoring of retail revenue, transaction volume, customer payment mix, and category-level sales performance to support data-driven retail decisions.

spec.title: Total Revenue
spec.description: Total revenue generated across all recorded retail transactions.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM transactions;

spec.title: Average Transaction Value
spec.description: Average customer spending per transaction, indicating the typical transaction value across all stores

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_transactions
FROM transactions;

spec.title: Average Transaction Value
spec.description: Average revenue generated per completed retail transaction.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS average_transaction_value
FROM transactions;

spec.title: Total Units Sold
spec.description: Total number of product units sold across all recorded retail transactions.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM transactions;

spec.title: Revenue by Category
spec.description: Revenue contribution across product categories to identify major sales drivers.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    category,
    SUM(total_amount) AS revenue
FROM transactions
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

spec.title: Transactions by Store
spec.description: Transaction volume by store to identify locations with higher customer activity.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    store_id,
    COUNT(transaction_id) AS total_transactions
FROM transactions
GROUP BY store_id
ORDER BY total_transactions DESC;

spec.title: Revenue by Payment Method
spec.description: Revenue contribution by payment method to identify customer payment preferences and support payment-channel optimization.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    payment_method,
    SUM(total_amount) AS revenue
FROM transactions
GROUP BY payment_method
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

spec.title: Quantity vs Unit Price
spec.description: Relationship between product price and quantity sold to identify high-volume and high-value products.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    unit_price,
    quantity
FROM transactions
WHERE category = 'Electronics'
ORDER BY unit_price;

SELECT
    unit_price,
    quantity
FROM transactions
WHERE category = 'Home'
ORDER BY unit_price;

SELECT
    unit_price,
    quantity
FROM transactions
WHERE category = 'Fashion'
ORDER BY unit_price;

SELECT
    unit_price,
    quantity
FROM transactions
WHERE category = 'Beauty'
ORDER BY unit_price;

spec.title: Store Revenue Mix by Category
spec.description: Compares total store revenue and the contribution of each product category to identify high-performing stores and category concentration.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    store_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Electronics' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS Electronics,
    SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Home' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS Home,
    SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Fashion' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS Fashion,
    SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Beauty' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS Beauty
FROM transactions
GROUP BY store_id
ORDER BY store_id;
